items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: So I got there, Tommy Darcy played and I played.

ctx.x: I heard of it that time.

Yeah, it was on Common and Drive. Tony DiNopolis had a place there. So they had a band from Scranton, Pennsylvania. Yeah, another one you're talking about. Yeah, sure. So Billy Lustig. So he came to the Palace and he says, Joe, Tony DiNopolis told him to come here and ask you if you want to take this job after you get off the theater. I said, yeah, how much you pay? He said, well I'll give you $100 and a quarter. I said, what? $100 and a quarter? I said, the trombone player had to go home and get operated. I…
